morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic cluster faces severe propane cost shock and plunging exports amid selective large-player recovery.
what_changed: Propane gas prices surged by Rs 7,300 per tonne ahead of Diwali, creating a severe input-cost shock for Morbi manufacturers.
Indian ceramic tile export volumes dropped steeply by 46% during April-July 2026, with a weak full-year FY27 outlook.
Varmora Granito reported a 498% jump in H1 profit driven by premium tile margins.
stress_signals: Propane prices spiked by Rs 7,300 per tonne ahead of Diwali, threatening operating margins [7b1fa98f465f].
Export volumes fell 46% between April and July 2026, signaling prolonged weakness in overseas demand [434975bd08e0].
A Morbi manufacturer faced a fraud loss of Rs 44.74 lakh after a credit buyer defaulted and became unreachable [29ed75c6450d].
improvement_signals: Varmora Granito's financial results indicate a broader ceramic tile industry recovery, led by premium tile margins [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c].
what_to_watch: Monitor sustainability of high propane prices post-Diwali and pass-through capability of MSMEs.
Track export order flows and realization trends for non-branded tile manufacturers.
Scrutinize credit sales terms and debtor aging reports to prevent buyer fraud and payment defaults.

surat.headline: Surat faces severe loom shutdowns, labor unrest, and pre-Diwali diamond payment defaults.
what_changed: A 50% jump in raw material costs triggered a scheduled month-long loom shutdown impacting 75,000 workers.
Embroidery units face an intensifying three-month labor dispute, while textile units also report eight-hour power cuts.
Multiple pre-Diwali payment defaults hit diamond processing, including a multi-crore uthamnu and unpaid artisan wages.
Textile units began structural diversification into defence technical fabrics for the Indian Army alongside FTA export expectations.
stress_signals: Textile loom slump with 50% raw material cost spike forcing a month-long shutdown affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6].

Pre-Diwali diamond defaults reported, including an uthamnu of crores of rupees [8f729a2b282e], over ₹20 lakh in unpaid wages for 20 artisans [402ab705574d], and a ₹70,000 polishing default [698c779932f2].
Prolonged three-month labor dispute in the embroidery sector set to intensify with new phases of agitation [8a31a5a2c20c, 442c4ff911f8, 29331b975c9e].
Operational disruption from an eight-hour power cut to textile units and market lighting curtailments due to electricity crisis [167f80ff6cdc, 5ae803461fe0].
improvement_signals: Textile manufacturers commenced production of defence fabrics for the Indian Army, expanding into defence technical textiles [4966bee026d8, 0f163b499572].
ICA-GemLab to open its first Indian testing laboratory for diamonds, gemstones, and jewellery in Surat [26bd1ecd549c].
Gems exporters working to rebuild US market business and diversify into new markets [37e6ab2a18cd].
what_to_watch: Working capital utilization and loan servicing capacity of weaving and embroidery job-work units during the one-month loom shutdown.
Contagion effects from the multi-crore pre-Diwali diamond default (uthamnu) on regional polishing units and trade payables.
Official notification and guidelines of the new textile policy expected within three months.
